title: JobCreated
description: A job was posted to a side's Tasking Board, OPEN (CONTRACTS §6; GAMEPLAY §1b TB-1, TB-10; NX-374). Posted by the board generator (the director and GM injection post through the same call later). Exactly one of node_id and blob_id is set, except an escort job (ESCORT_CONVOY), which sets neither and names the escorted truck in entity_id (sector_id joins with the sector scout). A job generated for a side references only what that side's view holds (TB-9). Public view: dropped for the ENEMY side's board.

entity_id.description: The truck an escort job covers (ESCORT_CONVOY), else null.
